support.name: Support
support.crumb: Reports / AI impact / Support org · FY2025
support.lead: Gnocchi read the ticketing system, the support team OKRs and every AI source support runs, and traced each AI tool to the ticket fields that move resolution time.

map.kr: Cut median time to resolution under 24 hours
map.why: a duration per ticket, then the typical ticket

map.blind: Attrition lives in the HR system, not in ticketing; connect the HRIS to see it

links.td_label: tickets where a field that moves resolution was set
links.trace_label: carry an agent write from auto-triage
links.bu_label: ChatGPT and copilot sessions matched to a ticket by customer, product and timing

impact.method: Rolled out to Tier 1 EMEA in March, Tier 1 NA in June, Tier 2 in September, never to Billing; each team compared with itself and with the teams not yet live, controlling for team and month.

decisions: Cuts resolution time where it runs; Billing is the one team without it.
Used daily; its effect on CSAT isn't separable yet. Run a 6-week holdout.
One team, few sessions; fold into the KB tool at renewal.
Shared across departments; support sessions link to tickets, so its share is counted.

hr.name: HR
hr.crumb: Reports / AI impact / People team · FY2025
hr.lead: Gnocchi read the applicant tracking system, the HR team OKRs and every AI source recruiting runs, and traced each AI tool to the requisition fields that move time to hire.

inventory.name: Job description writer
inventory.writes: JD draft attached to the requisition

map.kr: Cut median time to hire under 35 days
map.why: a duration per hire, then the typical hire

map.blind: No system records candidate experience; add a post-interview survey to see it

links.td_label: requisitions where a field that moves time to hire was set
links.trace_label: carry interview events written by the scheduling agent
links.bu_label: ChatGPT sessions matched to a requisition by role, team and timing

impact.method: Rolled out to Engineering hiring in February, Sales in May, G&A in August, never to Campus; each team compared with itself and with the teams not yet live, controlling for team and month.

decisions: Shortens time to hire where it runs.
Writes stages on every candidate, but screened-in candidates aren't hired faster; check what it optimizes.
Used by one team a few times a month; ChatGPT covers it.
Shared; recruiting sessions link to requisitions.
